items.title: Are you willing to pay $2,000 for an iPhone? These customers may.
items.summary: IDC Research Director Ramon Llamas talks with Market Domination's Josh Lipton about Apple's (AAPL) next product launch, which could unveil a foldable iPhone and will be the first launch with John Ternus as CEO.

items.title: Two deals, one Nvidia strategy: What's behind the chip giant's recent partnerships
items.summary: Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre takes a closer look at Nvidia's (NVDA) two newest deals: one with Taiwanese AI chip designer Mediatek (2454.TW), and one with Anthropic (ANTH.PVT) and Lambda.

items.title: SpaceX AI Buildout Shows Cracks as Musk Shakes Up Data Center Team
items.summary: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (NASDAQ:SPCX) has reshuffled its data-center leadership after engineering concerns and reliability problems emerged at facilities in Tennessee and Mississippi, The Information reported Tuesday. The shake-up comes as Elon Musk races to expand SpaceX’s AI infrastructure business...

items.title: Waymo taps into debt markets with $3B deal with Pimco, Blackstone - report
items.summary: Investing.com -- Waymo is close to securing its first debt financing, with Pacific Investment Management Co. and other lenders set to provide more than $3 billion to Alphabet Inc.'s autonomous driving unit, Bloomberg reported on Wednesday.

items.title: Sandisk Stock: Buy, Sell, or Hold?
items.summary: Sandisk has been crushing the S&P 500, and recent news from peer memory maker Samsung could extend its rally.

items.title: Alphabet Stock Edges Higher After Court Win
items.summary: Alphabet shares rose nearly 1% Wednesday after a federal judge rejected the Justice Department’s request to dismantle the online advertising business at the company's Google unit. Read more on the decision ...

items.title: Musk’s $30 Trillion AI Forecast Hinges on a Timeline Even NVIDIA Says Is Unrealistic
items.summary: Elon Musk told G20 leaders that AI and robotics will add up to $30 trillion a year to the global economy, naming a specific deadline. The supply chain constraints binding even NVIDIA suggest the math only works if you ignore how long industrial revolutions actually take.

items.title: Google Avoids Breakup of Dominant Ad Tech Business
items.summary: A federal judge ordered an end to practices that depress ad rates for web publishers, but declined to order a divestiture of Google’s ad exchange and other technology.
